title: Passenger Portal — sign-on prevented for invalid, no-journey or blocked cards
preface: This test is to confirm that Passenger Web Portal sign-on is prevented for invalid details, a card with no recent journeys, or a blocked card.
preconds: **GIVEN** the Passenger Web Portal sign-on page is displayed

steps.expected:
**THEN** the customer is prevented from signing on
**AND** the relevant message is shown

steps.content: **WHEN** the customer enters a card with no journeys in the previous seven days
steps.expected:
**THEN** the customer is prevented from signing on
**AND** the relevant message is shown

steps.content: **WHEN** the customer enters a blocked card
steps.expected:
**THEN** the customer is prevented from signing on
**AND** the relevant message is shown

change_note: Second half of C4102927's precondition question (gap Q26): the middle step's 'no journeys in the previous seven days' sign-on-block premise carries the same unconfirmed 7-day-sign-on-gate question as C4102927 (only a 7-day *view-window* limit is confirmed, not a sign-on gate). The 'invalid details' and 'blocked card' steps are standard, uncontradicted, low-risk UX (a blocked/deny-listed card being refused sign-on is consistent with the deny-list mechanism confirmed elsewhere, PSPEC-0015 4.9) and were left uncited per the register's existing 'assumed-competence, not every mechanical fact needs a bespoke citation' convention (cf. Q6/Q34) rather than over-marking. No wording change to the steps; only linked to the existing Q26 gap via Refs so the two related cases (4102927/4102928) are traceable together.

title: Passenger Portal — home screen shows balance and summary
preface: This test is to confirm that a signed-on customer sees their account balance and a summary of card, account ID and journey/transaction history.
preconds:
**GIVEN** a customer is signed on and the account home screen is displayed
**AND** the card has completed ABT taps that day

steps.content: **WHEN** the customer views the home screen
steps.expected:
**THEN** the account balance is shown
**AND** the card details, account ID and journey/transaction history summary is shown

change_note: Grounded: PSPEC-0015 para 14593 'The dashboard provides details of the customer's account, their current balance, the last 5 journeys and transactions and the ability to top up their account' (Anonymous Payment Card/Smartcard Dashboard, Figures 60-61). Citation added; no wording change — case was already accurate.

title: Passenger Portal — customer can sign off
preface: This test is to confirm that a customer can sign off the Passenger Web Portal.
preconds: **GIVEN** a customer is signed into the Passenger Web Portal

steps.expected:
**THEN** the session ends
**AND** the sign-on page is shown

change_note: No dedicated 'sign off' paragraph found in PSPEC-0015 or the Cloudfare Translink manual (a generic web-session sign-off is standard, uncontradicted UX, not itself in dispute). Left uncited rather than force a citation onto a trivial mechanical fact, per the register's existing 'assumed-competence' convention (cf. Q6/Q34) — no field actually changed on this case, listed here only for completeness of the section sweep.
